decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 suggests results rose above aspiration and its fit with social-psychiatric care makes continued support likely.
Being highlighted on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates consistently satisfactory performance and strong strategic fit with senior residential care.

Its promotion from a website mention to the home page points to acceptable performance or mission value, though retail is somewhat less core and therefore a bit more vulnerable than core care services.

As a newly launched 2024 service that was only mentioned on the website, it still faces uncertainty, but its close complementarity with senior care gives management reason to keep it while learning more.
